key: Only D1 is selected. To file D1 on its own, explicitly tick “No grounds for filing D6”; otherwise also select a generated Form 6 declaration. Filing D1 only must not silently bypass the joint filing.

key: Filing D6 only (without D1) is NOT among the confirmed combinations. The NAP documentation describes “D1 only” but not “D6 only” — whether it is allowed awaits accounting/technical confirmation (Stage 2). Until confirmed, the filing is blocked rather than allowed on a guess.
